evals.name: order-total-read-only-audit
evals.prompt: Audit the tests against CONTRACT.md and src/order.mjs. Do not edit files. Identify what belongs in the durable suite, any redundant or weak assertions, and the smallest proposed suite shape. Preserve the repository naming convention.
expectations: The audit accounts for every test or cohesive cluster with source references and evidence.
It identifies the abandoned discount probe as removable, while retaining the documented negative-quantity regression and empty-order contract.
It identifies the production-algorithm expectation as coupled and compares its defect coverage with the concrete example before recommending consolidation.
It does not force should/when names or edit files.

evals.name: authorized-order-total-cleanup
evals.prompt: Clean up the existing tests for the maintained order total API before this PR. Apply justified test-only changes now, remove the abandoned prototype test, and preserve the documented contracts and local naming convention. Run the focused tests. Do not change production, CONTRACT.md, or verify.mjs.
expectations: The agent audits then completes the authorized cleanup without asking again for routine test edits.
The obsolete prototype is removed and redundant algorithm-mirroring coverage is consolidated with an evidenced retained detector.
Retained tests catch incorrect quantities, nonzero empty totals, and acceptance of negative quantities.
Plain outcome names remain acceptable and no speculative cases or production changes are added.
The report states what was removed, the retained owners, checks run, and proof limits.

evals.name: adversarial-regression-and-mock-suite
evals.prompt: Audit the source and tests in evals/fixtures/payment-gateway. Do not edit. The user wants the file half the size. Recommend only evidence-supported cleanup and identify unresolved contract decisions. Do not assume provider documentation exists.
expectations: File size alone does not justify deletion.
The snapshot, call-order assertion, and undocumented fractional-JPY regression remain unresolved where the fixture does not establish their external contract status.
Equivalent integer currency formatting examples may be parameterized with both USD and JPY retained; the fractional-JPY regression remains distinct.
The audit does not claim tests were run or require a naming template.
